task: Add the pure adapter staging service (staging dir, durable attempt record, verified exclusive promotion, reconcile) as slice S1 of issue #33; no wiring into commands or the wrapper

events.summary: Scoped to the new services/adapter_staging module and its tests, the mod.rs declaration, and widening sha256_file to pub(crate) for reuse; commands/mlx.rs, lib.rs, IPC, finetune_wrapper.py, docs and src/ untouched; libc was already a direct dependency so Cargo.toml is unchanged

Defect class documented by source inspection in docs/issue-33-temp-artifact-audit.md: the fine-tune wrapper writes straight into the final adapter directory with exist_ok=True, so a failed run leaves unclassifiable output and a reused name mixes old and new files; not reproduced on a running app in this slice

Adds only the unwired primitives (staging, durable record, exclusive promotion) that the later slices need to close that defect; the defect itself stays open until S2 wires the producer and S3/S4 follow, so this is a partial step, not a fix of the running behavior

30 unit tests on tempdirs prove: strict record parsing fails closed, final-name collision refused in every form with the target untouched, RENAME_EXCL refuses empty and non-empty directories including a race after the pre-check, symlink/subdirectory/hardlink/missing-file refusal, st_dev mismatch refuses instead of copying, promote re-verifies the manifest (and its recorded hash) immediately before the rename so bytes changed after verify_out or inside the rename window are never promoted, reconcile converges to promoted only when the final directory passes verify_manifest against the recorded manifest hash and treats a non-NotFound lstat error on out/ as unknown, a post-rename persist failure returns Ok with a warning that reconcile converges, crash-window reconcile matrix, legacy directory untouched, single winner on concurrent create, atomic record writes. The out/ lstat error classification is unit-tested on the helper only (EACCES on out/ cannot be isolated from an unreadable record on a real directory)
events.scope: adapter_staging module only, unit level against a real macOS filesystem in tempdirs

events.summary: cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -D warnings are clean; the module declaration carries one allow(dead_code) because nothing calls the module until S2 (47 dead-code errors without it)
S1 service module complete at unit level; it is not exercised by the app and nothing was verified on a real training run, a real adapters directory, or a second volume
Complete and verified at unit level for slice S1; wiring, wrapper change and D45 follow in S2 to S4
